correctness.rationale: Proved the necessary bound of at most one initially white vertex per peripheral clique, then exhausted hub-filled/hub-unfilled cases and incomplete-blade counts. Thresholds L,U,H,T are both necessary and sufficient; binomial enumeration gives every coefficient. Deriving the minimal exponent yields the four phase intervals. Exact-rational simulations of all labelled seed sets for 337 graph/parameter pairs matched the full polynomial; finite tests do not establish the infinite theorem.

originality.rationale: The new claim is the complete all-parameter transmission forcing-set polynomial of equal-clique bouquets, including the L<beta<=T alpha-squared threshold, with structural jumps and non-upward closure. The primary paper gives the forcing rules, degree bounds and unrelated graph-family calculations. A published ordinary friendship-graph polynomial covers only the low-beta m=2 specialization, and a complete-multipartite transmission formula applies to a different graph class. Full-priority assurance cannot be established for unindexed sources.

value.rationale: This is a complete forcing-set distribution for a natural unbounded two-parameter family of connected block graphs, not an arbitrary slice. It identifies the intermediate alpha^2 two-round threshold, arbitrarily large k-2 jumps between optimal seed counts at a sharp boundary, and concrete loss of upward closure. The previously published general maximum-degree criterion and classical friendship-graph seed polynomial do not resolve this intermediate behavior.
